_about: Elizabeth Bowen. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: Collected Stories. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling; each row is US public domain (title page, Gutenberg header or IA metadata read, recorded in _bloom).

bowen-encounters.evidence: djvu head read: "Encounters: Stories by Elizabeth Bowen / Boni and Liveright Publishers New York", printed in Great Britain; contents Breakfast ... Coming Home (14 stories). Toronto (robarts), not a lending item.
bowen-encounters.case: Bloom lists the Collected Stories (1980, not PD as a book), which reprints her first two story collections whole; Encounters (1923) and Ann Lee's (1926) are US-PD and give the PD third of the book.
bowen-encounters.note: Partial by nature: Joining Charles (1929) is PD too but IA has only 1952 lending copies; later stories are not PD. Check the Encounters scan for a later printing line before ingesting (printing year OCR garbled).
